custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the edges of the hair. AI generators often struggle with fine, thin structures like individual hair strands, leading to 'clumping' or 'smearing' at the boundaries. Verify if the hair looks like distinct strands or painted-on textures. Also, check the mannequin faces/heads for any structural anomalies, as they are secondary subjects but their distortion could indicate broader generation issues.
